'''Kuuvat''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who served as the head of [[Pok Nar-Ten]]'s guards. A no-nonsense [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], he was loyal to Pok Nar-Ten.
